disclaimer.title: Before you start
disclaimer.p1: Kitroid POS runs entirely on this device. Your shop data is stored only in this browser, not on Kitroid's servers. Kitroid cannot see, recover or restore it.
disclaimer.p2: If you clear browser data, uninstall the app or lose this device, your data will be lost unless you have a backup. Back up to your own Google Drive or download a backup file regularly.
disclaimer.p3: Kitroid is provided free, as is, without warranty. You use it at your own risk and are responsible for your records, prices and taxes.

google.title: Backups to your own Google Drive
google.body: Kitroid works without any account. If you choose "Connect Google Drive" in a tool's Backup screen, you sign in with your own Google account and Kitroid asks for one permission: to create backup files in your Google Drive and open only the files it created (drive.file). Backups go straight from your browser to your Drive. Kitroid has no server and never sees your files, your Google account details or your access token. You can remove access at any time in your Google account.

tt.title: Kitroid Tong Tin
tt.tagline: Run your savings circle: hands, rounds, bids and who has paid, on this device.

welcome.title: Start your Tong Tin book
welcome.disclaimer: Your circles are stored only on this device. If you clear the browser or lose the device they are gone, unless you back up. Kitroid cannot see or recover them. A savings circle is an agreement between people: Kitroid only helps you keep the record. Use at your own risk.

tt.empty: No circles yet. Create one with the people in your circle, then record each round as it happens.

modeHint.BID: Each round, hands that have not taken the pot bid a discount. The highest bid takes the pot; the others who have not taken it pay the amount minus the bid, and those who already took it pay the full amount.
modeHint.ORDER: No bids. The pot goes to each hand in the order of the list, everyone pays the full amount.

tt.lockedAfterDraw: Amount, dates and rules are locked after the first round, so past rounds stay correct.
tt.amountHint: What one hand pays each round.
tt.headFirstHint: Common practice: the head collects the full first round without bidding, then pays the full amount every round.
tt.membersHint: The first name is the head. A person with two hands is written twice.
tt.closedNote: This circle is closed. Reopen it to record more rounds.
tt.finishedNote: Every hand has taken the pot. The circle is complete.
tt.needHands: Add at least 2 hands to start.
tt.headRoundNote: Round 1 goes to the head ({name}) with no bid.
tt.undoConfirm: Undo round {n}? Its payments are removed too.
tt.name: Name
tt.netHint: Net = pot received − shares due so far. At the end, early hands are negative (they borrowed) and late hands positive (they saved and earned).
tt.handsLocked: Hands can no longer be added after round 1 is recorded.
tt.head: head
tt.cannotRemove: This hand has rounds or payments and cannot be removed.
tt.deleteConfirm: Delete "{name}" with all its rounds and payments? This cannot be undone (unless you have a backup).
tt.planIntro: See what each turn receives, pays and gains before you start. Early turns borrow, late turns save.
tt.firstBid: Expected bid in the first bidding round
tt.lastBid: Expected bid in the last round
tt.planNote: Rate per round is the interest that turn earns (+) or pays (−) each round, for comparing with a bank loan or deposit. Real bids change every round.
tt.changeWinnerConfirm: Go back to the bids for this round? Payments ticked for it are removed.
tt.alreadyReceived: Already received the pot: pays full
tt.closeUnpaid: {n} have not paid yet. Close anyway? They stay in "still owed" and you can tick them later.
tt.legendUnpaid: not paid yet (tap to mark paid)
tt.sheetHint: Amounts in {cur}. Each column is one round; scroll sideways for more rounds. Tap an amber amount when that person pays.
tt.waitingCount: {n} hands have not taken the pot yet
tt.finalBidHint: Only the final, highest bid. Hands still waiting pay the amount minus this.

privacy.title: Privacy & lock
privacy.body: Ask for a PIN when this tool opens and after a few minutes away, so other people using this phone or computer cannot open it. The screen is hidden while you switch apps.
privacy.honest: The lock stops other people using this device from opening the tool. It does not encrypt the data stored on the device: anyone with full access to the device and technical tools could still read it. Keep your phone locked too. Backups can be encrypted with a password (see Backup).
privacy.wait: Too many wrong tries. Try again in {n} min.
privacy.forgot: Forgot the PIN? Clear this site's data in your browser settings and restore from a backup.

privacy.wipeHint: For example before you sell or give away this device.
privacy.csvWarn: This file contains private health information and is not encrypted. Share it only with people you trust, and delete it when done.
